ios.desc:
The ultimate countdown app for tracking anything. Never miss life's milestones with Tickr, your personal countdown companion!
Turn anticipation into excitement with customizable countdowns for every important event in your life. Whether it's a dream vacation, your wedding day, or an important deadline, Tickr keeps you motivated and organized.
Why choose Tickr?
* Create unlimited custom countdowns
* Personalize with emojis and colors
* Track multiple events simultaneously
* Sleek widgets for at-a-glance updates
* Set smart reminders
* Simple, intuitive interface
* 100% ad-free experience
Available for iOS, Tickr offers core features for free and a Pro upgrade for power users who want even more!
Never lose sight of what matters. From life-changing events to weekend getaways, Tickr transforms every countdown into an exciting journey.
Download Tickr now and start counting down to your dreams!
